name: GSS transfer takes tokens out of the pair without sync
summary: GSS's transfer path removes tokens from the GSS/USDT pair's own balance without calling sync(), so ten hours after deployment the attacker skimmed the resulting surplus and swapped it for the pair's USDT.
notes: The owner's fee cuts after deployment only changed rates. Loss is the pair's USDT; its GSS is valued at nothing (rule 12).
